name: HTTP Request
label: HTTP Request
description: Generic HTTP client (JDK HttpClient). Sends an allowlisted method + absolute http(s) URL with optional headers and a JSON or text body, then returns port output as a map {result, http_status} on 2xx. Use Web Browser when you need stripped page text and robots.txt; use this when you need a specific method, custom headers, or a request body. Methods other than GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS are rejected (Python forwarded arbitrary verbs). TLS-verify-off is lab-only. Egress is governed by the daemon's network posture (SSRF guard); this node never bypasses engine network rules.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: HTTP call. Required: url (non-empty absolute http or https URL). Optional: method (default GET; allowlist GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS), headers (object merged on top of defaultHeaders), body (object → JSON body; string → raw text body), body_text (string → raw body). body_text wins over body-as-string. If both JSON and text bodies resolve, Java sends only the JSON body. Port output is a map {result, http_status} on 2xx.

schema.label: method
schema.description: Purpose: HTTP verb sent by the Java handler (stored upper-case after trim). Default: 'GET' when omitted, null, or blank. EXACT accepted values (case-insensitive): 'GET' (read, typically no body), 'POST' (create or submit JSON/form), 'PUT' (replace a resource), 'PATCH' (partial update), 'DELETE' (remove a resource), 'HEAD' (headers only), 'OPTIONS' (CORS/preflight or allowed-methods probe). Any other verb (TRACE, CONNECT, PROPFIND, custom tokens, …) is rejected with result 'HTTP Request Error: method not allowed: {METHOD}' and is not sent — Java does not forward arbitrary verbs (Python requests.request did). Example: 'GET'. Example write: 'POST'. Example rejected: 'TRACE'.

schema.label: url
schema.description: Purpose: absolute request URL passed to JDK HttpClient. REQUIRED. Empty, missing, or whitespace-only fails with result='URL is missing' (no request is sent). EXACT accepted schemes: 'http' and 'https' only (java.net.http has no other adapters). Include path, query string, and port as needed. Missing or non-http(s) scheme returns result 'HTTP Request Error: unsupported URL scheme: {scheme|(none)}' without throwing. Malformed URIs return 'HTTP Request Error: {message}'. Examples: 'https://httpbin.org/get', 'https://api.example.com/v1/items?limit=10', 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/health'. Rejected examples: 'ftp://files.example.com/a', 'example.com/path' (no scheme). Do not pass a search query; this is not a crawler.

schema.label: headers
schema.description: Purpose: per-call HTTP headers merged on TOP of configuration defaultHeaders (call keys win on conflict). Accepted values: a JSON object of string→string, a JSON object string, or omit/{}. Invalid JSON is treated as {}. After merge, if no User-Agent is present (case-insensitive), Chrome/120 on Windows NT 10.0 is set AND, only then, if Accept is missing it is set to 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8' AND if Accept-Language is missing it is set to 'en-US,en;q=0.9' (Python added Accept/Accept-Language only when it also added the UA). Authorization values are sent but never logged. Example: {"Accept":"application/json","Authorization":"Bearer TOKEN","X-Request-Id":"abc-123"}. Example to override UA: {"User-Agent":"MyAgent/1.0"}. Omit or {} when defaults are enough.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Purpose: request body. Accepted values: a JSON object/dict, a string, another non-null scalar/array, or omit. A JSON object/dict is serialized with Json.write and sent as UTF-8 (Content-Type application/json is added when missing). A string is sent as UTF-8 raw bytes unless body_text is a string. Any other non-null non-dict type is str()'d and sent as UTF-8 text. If both a JSON body and a text body resolve, Java sends only the JSON body (HttpClient has one publisher). Example JSON object: {"query":"bpmn","max_results":5}. Example PATCH: {"status":"published"}. Example string: 'plain text payload'. Omit for GET/HEAD when no payload is needed.

schema.label: body_text
schema.description: Purpose: raw request body as a UTF-8 string. Accepted values: any Java/JSON string (including empty). Applied only when the value is a string; numbers/objects on this field are ignored. Sent only when body is not a JSON object/dict. Content-Type is NOT auto-set — set it in headers (e.g. 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'text/plain', 'application/xml'). Difference vs body: never serialized as JSON. Example form: 'grant_type=client_credentials&scope=read'. Example XML: '<note>hello</note>'. Example plaintext: 'ping'. Omit for GET/HEAD.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Formatted HTTP response map on port output for 2xx: result (preview text) and http_status (numeric). Credential header values are redacted from error messages. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: result
http_status
schema.description: Numeric HTTP status from the Status: line in result when the call returned 2xx.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: connect + request timeout in seconds for every call (both HttpClient connectTimeout and request timeout). Default: 20 when omitted, blank, or not numeric — Java toInt never throws (Python int() on a bad value could raise and fail the node). Accepted values: any number or numeric string; non-numeric → 20. Values below 1 are clamped to 1 by the HTTP helper. Example: 20. Example for a slow API: 45. Example invalid 'abc' → 20.

configurationParameters.label: Verify TLS
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: whether to verify the server TLS certificate. Default: true (verify). EXACT disable rule: only the string 'false' (any case, surrounding whitespace ignored) disables verification — matching Python str(verify_cfg).lower() != 'false' via WebNodeSupport.verifyTls. 'true', '1', 'yes', '0', empty, and any other token all VERIFY. Options: 'false' | 'true'. Example: true. Set 'false' only for lab hosts with self-signed certs — disabling verification is not for production and is lab-only.

configurationParameters.label: Default Headers
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: headers applied to every call, then overridden by input.headers (call wins). Accepted values: a JSON object string, an already-decoded object/map, or empty. Invalid JSON is treated as {}. Example: '{"Accept":"application/json","X-Client":"studioquack"}'. Example with auth (prefer a secret manager in production): '{"Authorization":"Bearer TOKEN"}'. Do not put secrets in this field if the instance config is shared. Merged keys keep the casing given; User-Agent / Accept / Accept-Language presence is checked case-insensitively after the merge. Authorization values are never logged.
